comment: The metrics interface-name form (doc/design/metrics.md "Limits"): crhs's packages/protocol/src/messages.ts isValidMetricsInterfaceName and crha's client/internal/protocol/types.go ValidMetricsInterfaceName must agree on every case. A name is 1-15 bytes of UTF-8, not "." or "..", and contains no '/', ':', Unicode white space or control character. The hex entries are names whose bytes are not valid UTF-8: Go rejects them directly, and crhs's CBOR profile rejects a text item that carries them, so a name on the wire is always valid UTF-8.
